policy: Only reviewed full-film expanded editions. A theatrical IMAX credit or filename alone is insufficient. Unknown candidates remain excluded until their home edition is reviewed. File-level playback is not verified.

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War
movies.evidence: IMAX confirms whole-film expanded presentation; Disney confirms the IMAX Enhanced home edition.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame
movies.evidence: The official IMAX comparison describes the entire film as expanded; Disney confirms the home edition.

movies.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
movies.evidence: The IMAX theater operator describes the entire IMAX presentation; Disney confirms the IMAX Enhanced home edition.

movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
movies.evidence: IMAX's press release explicitly confirms whole-film expanded aspect ratio; Disney lists the home edition.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.evidence: Community restoration documentation identifies the full-frame Open Matte edition. Select an Open Matte file; the standard widescreen release does not qualify. This is community evidence rather than studio certification.
